text_blocks.snippet: In 2021/22, India, Poland, Pakistan, Romania, and Ireland were the top five countries of birth for UK migrants, accounting for 32% of the foreign-born population. By nationality, India, Pakistan, and Nigeria were major contributors to UK immigration in recent years, particularly for work and study visas. Since Brexit, non-EU immigration, especially from these countries, has significantly increased.
